Job Summary
Build and deploy AI-powered applications using modern LLMs, machine learning frameworks, and cloud infrastructure, collaborating with product and engineering teams to deliver intelligent, production-ready solutions.
Responsibilities
Design and build AI-powered applications and intelligent workflows
Develop and optimize solutions using LLMs and generative AI models
Build APIs and backend services to power AI applications
Implement RAG pipelines, vector databases, and prompt engineering
Integrate third-party AI services and cloud platforms
Monitor, evaluate, and improve AI model performance
Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams
Write clean, scalable, and well-tested production code
Requirements
3+ years of software engineering or AI development experience
Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI frameworks
Hands-on experience with LLMs, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar models
Experience building RAG systems and vector database solutions
Knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP
Strong understanding of APIs, databases, and software architecture
Excellent problem-solving skills and communication abilities
Job Details
Experience: 3+ Years
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full time (40 hrs/week)
Start Date: ASAP
Our Culture
Were a close-knit crew.
More family than coworkers. We win together, celebrate together, and have each others backs.
Respecting your time.
Clear scopes, realistic timelines, and zero time-waste. We value your time as much as you do.
Entrepreneurial at heart.
We move fast, take ownership, and arent afraid to build, break, learn, and build again.
Low ego, high impact.
Great ideas come from anywhere. We listen, respect, and lift each other up.
Built to last.
Low attrition, high trust. People stay because they love the work and the people.
